description.en: Plugins for the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏用的插件。

description.en: Lists installed plugins and where each one lives, pins favourites, opens a plugin folder in Finder, and adds a plugin market: catalog growth trends, a 7-day growth ranking, whole-catalog search with Chinese terms, and one-click install.
description.zh: 列出已安装插件并标出入口位置，支持置顶与在访达定位目录；市场页提供目录增长趋势、7 天增长榜、支持中文的全库搜索和一键安装。

description.en: Adds a native "Phone access (iOS)" settings page with four switchable methods: LAN, Cloudflare (zero install on the phone), Tailscale (fixed address), and EasyTier. Scan to sign in — no password, and rebuilds no longer require rescanning. Ships a CLI (pair / status / mode / doctor) for servers without a GUI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页新增原生「手机访问（iOS）」：局域网 / Cloudflare / Tailscale / EasyTier 四种方式可随时切换。扫码即连、无需密码；重装后也不必重新扫码。附带 CLI（pair / status / mode / doctor），无图形界面的服务器可在终端出码。
